verdict.rationale: Sentry has its own first-party Webhooks documentation page under its Integration Platform (sentry-docs-25), which points to registrable outbound HTTP callbacks rather than chat-app notifications. The pack contains only that page title and URL, so which events can be subscribed to, how payloads look, and how deliveries are verified or retried are not shown. Missing for 10: documented event types and subscription scope, payload schema, signature verification and retry semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
